nodes.label: Candidate List Non-Widening Security Invariant
nodes.rationale: firestore.rules enforces candidateListNotWidened so that a referral's routing candidate facility list may only ever shrink (e.g. via patient decline) and can never be expanded by a client write, preventing routing manipulation.

nodes.label: 30-Minute Fast-Track SLA Breach Threshold
nodes.rationale: src/lib/sla.ts tracks a 30-minute (1800s) fast-track SLA window with sub-second boundary precision (1799.999s not breached vs 1800.000s breached) and idempotent auto-escalation so concurrent SLA sweep runs never produce duplicate audit log entries.

nodes.label: Bed Capacity Stepper Debounced Writes
nodes.rationale: BedManagementPage.tsx uses pendingUpdatesRef and writeTimersRef with a 500ms debounce per bed type so rapid stepper clicks update local UI instantly while batching a single aggregated Firestore write, and flushPendingWrites on unmount guarantees no in-flight change is lost when navigating away.

nodes.label: Zero-Capacity Division Guard
nodes.rationale: BedCapacityCard.tsx clamps total/occupied with Math.max/Math.min and guards ratio and occupancyPercentage division behind safeTotal > 0 checks, so a 0-capacity bed unit renders '0%' and '0 free of 0' instead of NaN or a runtime crash.

nodes.label: Pain Point: Navigation Paradigm Friction

nodes.label: Accompanying Doctor Escort Gate
nodes.rationale: When requiresAccompanyingDoctor is true, ambulance dispatch to in_transit is blocked until an escort doctor's name and phone are assigned by ER staff. This is enforced redundantly across Firestore security rules, unit/simulation tests, and Playwright E2E to guarantee clinical safety cannot be bypassed at any layer.

nodes.label: Pre-Transit Cancellation Lock
nodes.rationale: Referral cancellation is permitted only in pre-transit statuses (pending, dept_approved, manager_approved, accepted); once a referral reaches in_transit, arrived, admitted, or discharged, cancellation is permanently locked to prevent disrupting an active physical patient transfer.
